mapper.select: select * from user_address where user_id = #{userId} order by is_default desc, id
mapper.update: update user_address set is_default = 0 where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into user_address(user_id, receiver_name, phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default) values(#{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{phone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detailAddress}, #{isDefault})
mapper.update: update user_address set is_default = 1 where id = #{id}
